data.name: Euphoria: Supreme Mechanics VR
data.detailed_description:
Euphoria: Supreme Mechanics VR is a first-person VR puzzle game. Step into a futuristic sci-fi world where logic and environmental interaction rule everything. Solve challenging puzzles, manipulate lasers, and carve your path through enigmatic high-tech labs.

Story

You are an engineer who awakens in a mysterious research facility. The complex seems abandoned, yet its mechanisms are still running. Why are you here? Who left these trials behind? As you solve puzzles, you will gradually uncover the story of the facility — and your own role in its tangled narrative. All that remains are lasers, cubes… and endless questions.

Gameplay

Core interactions revolve around regular and energy cubes, buttons, and lasers. You’ll need to place, rotate, and combine them to activate mechanisms, unlock passages, and solve intricate tasks. With VR controllers, you directly interact with objects: lift, move, and rotate cubes; redirect laser beams; activate panels; and open doors. Every puzzle is a unique challenge that requires you to think creatively, while also considering physics and perspective. Thanks to the VR format, you will literally feel each detail: the weight of a cube in your hands, the reflection of a laser beam, the hum of machinery, and the vastness of the surrounding environment.

Key Features

● Full VR support: deep immersion through physical interaction with objects.
● Free movement and teleportation options for player comfort.
● Unique puzzles: every challenge demands creative thinking and precision.
● Expressive and atmospheric sci-fi visual style.
● Immersive sound design and a captivating soundtrack.

  • Processor: Intel core i5-9xxx
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060

  • VR Support: SteamVR, Oculus Touch, Valve Index.
